title: Subsidy360 canonical scheme record
description: Shape every record is normalised into before it reaches the interface. A field the source does not state must be null — never a guess. Null renders as 'Not reported'.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across the catalogue. Later packs supersede earlier ones on collision.

dept.description: Administering ministry or state department, as stated by the source.

states.description: "all" for nationally available schemes, otherwise the list of states/UTs where it applies.

benefit.description: What the scheme provides, in the source's own terms. Null if not stated.

maxBenefitL.description: Maximum support in ₹ lakh, ONLY where the source states a ceiling. Null otherwise — never derived.

source.description: Official portal or notification. Records without a source are rejected at import.

verified.description: Month the record was last checked against its source, e.g. "Jul 2026". Null if never verified.

allocationCr.description: Budget figures in ₹ crore. BE, RE and Actual are separate and never interconverted.
